title: Foods and drinks and who invented them

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?inventorLabel ?countryLabel ?invented WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?inv) AS ?inventor) (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(STR(?incT), ""), "|", COALESCE(STR(?incP), "")); separator=";") AS ?invented) WHERE { ?item wdt:P61 ?inv ; wdt:P31 ?directClass ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . ?directClass wdt:P279* ?root . VALUES ?root { wd:Q2095 wd:Q40050 wd:Q746549 wd:Q844482 wd:Q10943 wd:Q5159627 } FILTER(?sitelinks > 6) OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P495 ?c } OPTIONAL { ?item p:P571 ?incSt . ?incSt a wikibase:BestRank ; psv:P571 [ wikibase:timeValue ?incT ; wikibase:timePrecision ?incP ] . } } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 199

inventor.match: Match each food or drink to who invented it.

country.match: Match each food or drink to the country it comes from.
country.odd: Three of these come from {value}. Which one doesn't?
country.all: Tap all {n} foods and drinks that come from {value}.

year_invented.sort: from the oldest to the newest
year_invented.era: Drop each food or drink into the era it was invented.
year_invented.shot: In what year was {label} first made? It {hook}.

rows.label: umami
rows.description: one of the five basic tastes
rows.hook: is the savory fifth basic taste, found in mushrooms, tomatoes and aged cheese

rows.label: Vegemite
rows.hook: is a dark, salty yeast-extract spread that people put thinly on buttered toast

rows.label: vermouth
rows.description: alcoholic beverage, type of aromatized wine
rows.hook: is a fortified, herb-infused wine that is a key ingredient in Martinis and Manhattans

rows.label: Bloody Mary
rows.description: cocktail containing vodka and tomato juice
rows.hook: is a brunch cocktail of vodka and tomato juice, often garnished with celery

rows.label: Mai Tai
rows.description: cocktail based on rum, Curaçao liqueur and lime juice
rows.hook: is a tiki cocktail of rum, orange liqueur and lime, served with a mint sprig

rows.label: takoyaki
rows.hook: is a street snack of wheat-batter balls with octopus, topped with sauce and bonito flakes

rows.label: Angostura bitters
rows.description: concentrated bitter made of water, alcohol, herbs and spices
rows.hook: is an aromatic dash-sized flavoring that gives Old Fashioneds and Manhattans their spice

rows.label: Waldorf salad
rows.hook: combines chopped apples, celery, grapes and walnuts in mayonnaise, first served at a famous New York hotel

rows.label: Daiquiri
rows.description: family of cocktails with with rum, citrus and some sweetener
rows.hook: is a classic mix of white rum, lime juice and sugar, named after a mining town

rows.label: Vesper
rows.description: cocktail originally made of gin, vodka, and Kina Lillet
rows.hook: is the shaken-not-stirred drink ordered by James Bond in Casino Royale

rows.label: Espresso martini
rows.hook: is a vodka cocktail with coffee liqueur, created to wake a customer up

rows.label: Hawaiian pizza
rows.description: pizza variety, usually topped with pineapple pieces and ham
rows.hook: is topped with ham and pineapple, a sweet-and-savory combo that sparks endless debate
